Method of Attack: Denial-of-service (DoS) by crashing device firmware or causing freezes via deadlock conditions blocking Bluetooth communication
Arbitrary code execution leading to complete takeover depending on vulnerable SoC
Impacted Systems: Bluetooth devices with vulnerable System-on-a-Chip (SoC) from Intel, Qualcomm, Texas Instruments, Cypress
Attack Vector: Bluetooth communication exploiting vulnerabilities in Bluetooth stacks on SoCs
Use of off-the-shelf ESP32 board with custom Link Manager Protocol (LMP) firmware and computer running proof-of-concept tool
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept tool released publicly to test Bluetooth devices against BrakTooth exploits
